title.narrative: Increasing access to DOTS in Sudan with a focus on hard to reach populations - Sudan (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Sudan, Tuberculosis, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP Sudan)This program has the following goals: To decrease TB burden in Sudan in line with the Global End TB strategy. The objectives of this program are: increased case detection from 60.5% to 76% and improve treatment outcome to achive 90% treatment success rate by end of 2020.. Health system in all states is reoriented to provide integrated TB/HIV services, increase annual detection and improve treatment outcome of MDR-TB cases.. TB monitoring and evaluation system is strengthened at national , states, locality levels and in TBMUs to improve quality and completeness of data, and improve data use.. Laboratoty systems improved, quality TB control programme performance sustained at national and state levels in an enabling environment, and guided by national and international standards. Achieve high political commitment to support the implementation of TB Activities at all levels, with social support to all TB patients and reduced stigma .
